description: September 24 birthday meaning: Virgo or Libra cusp, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, September 24 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Virgo or Libra. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: September 24 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Edge-of-season birthdays like September 24 can still occasionally fall in Virgo, depending on year and time, though most years place the Sun at about one degree of Libra. That early Libra position doubles Venus, as sign ruler and decan ruler. With the birthday number 6, linked with care and home, the reading leans towards a gracious peacemaker who builds beautiful, harmonious households.

On September 24 the Sun usually sits at about 1° Libra, in the first decan, where Venus rules the decan as well as the sign. Born around September 21 to September 23, close to the equinox, you sit between Virgo and Libra. Earth hands over to air, and practicality to partnership. The precise day and minute of the Sun's move into Libra changes with the year, so your actual sign depends on birth year, time and location, which a natal chart can resolve. Those who feel both influences are often described as refined and thoughtful: careful about details, invested in fairness and drawn to beauty that also works. Decisions may take time, because both signs like to get things right.

sections.heading: September 24 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 24th reduces as 2 + 4 = 6. The compound combines the 2's emotional attentiveness and the 4's reliability, feeding into the 6's devotion to home and community. Those born on this day are often described as dependable carers: the one who brings soup, fixes the shelf and remembers what you said last month. Stability in family life tends to matter a great deal to them. As a secondary number, the 24 points towards a gift for creating safe, well-run spaces. Accepting help in return is often their quiet area of growth.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one September 24 birthday to the next: it is 22 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22.

sections.heading: Born on September 24: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 24 is the 267th day of the year (268th in a leap year). By October 24, 30 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Scorpio.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by September 24, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on September 24 include F. Scott Fitzgerald (1896), İsmet İnönü (1884) and Horace Walpole (1717).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 24?
faq.answer: September 24 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Virgo or Libra on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Libra. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 24?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 24 the Life Path is 22 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 24th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 24?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a September 24 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 24?
faq.answer: September 24 is also the birthday of F. Scott Fitzgerald (1896), İsmet İnönü (1884) and Horace Walpole (1717). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
